notablePrerequisites: Quest for Pure Flame has at least four quest counters on it.
description:
Activate Quest for Pure Flame by removing four quest counters from it and sacrificing it, doubling the amount of damage sources you control deal this turn.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2 as desired.

uses.name: Deathbringer Thoctar
uses.cardState: with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

uses.name: Quest for Pure Flame
uses.cardState: with four or more quest counters on it
